kurz: Short butter biscuits that hold their shape when cut and shine golden with egg yolk: cold dough and little kneading do the trick.
bild_im_kopf: Like sand on the beach: pressed together loosely it holds its shape, kneaded too hard it turns tough.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Cream soft butter with sugar until pale, add eggs and lemon zest
schluesselmomente.warum: Creaming beats in a little air, so the biscuits turn tender rather than hard.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Mix in the flour only briefly, until no dry flour is visible
schluesselmomente.warum: The less it is kneaded, the less gluten forms. That keeps the biscuits short.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Chill the dough for at least an hour, then roll out about 7 mm thick and cut out (as a guide)
schluesselmomente.warum: Cold butter is firm: the dough does not stick and the shapes do not spread in the oven.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Brush twice with egg yolk, bake at about 200 °C for 8–10 minutes (as a guide)
schluesselmomente.warum: The protein and sugar in the yolk brown quickly and give the golden sheen.
